energy.mellow: 25 Energy per three minutes = 500/hour, not the upstream calculator's 600.
energy.xlPotion: 50 Energy per ten minutes = 300/hour under continuous-use assumption; costs also use six doses/hour. Old 275/hour was unsupported while billing six doses.
energy.miraculous: One planned dose adds its 500 usable-Energy reserve and at most one hour of +30/tick recovery. Session calculation removes its recovery after expiry and no longer implies indefinite gathering or hourly reuse. Session cost bills one dose. 22-hour cooldown is stated, not an automatic scheduler.
energy.exclusivity: Mystical and Mellow cannot both contribute, including direct/legacy calculator callers. Checkbox selection replaces the conflicting medicine; invalid saved IDs are not silently erased.
energy.limitations: Continuous-rate approximation assumes refills are ready and fully usable, with no tick timing, max-Energy overflow, owned-quantity or cooldown schedule. Other selected Energy buffs remain included by the user in Recovery / 3 min, explicitly excluding the mapped medicines. Costs/hour include the single Miraculous dose in the first hour. A session beyond 22 hours still plans only one dose.
